audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ornn level 2 and both item rows while calling levels 4-5 and level 6 'Skill' — the reverse of what the content whys say and of what the packet records.
audit.why: The packet chart and the mirror ornn__sylas both read Skill / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Sylas. Ornn owns levels 3 through 6 because Volcanic Rupture's pillar plus Searing Charge is a knockup on demand against a champion whose only entry is a 400-range dash; Sylas takes the two-item row on AP scaling.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items flipped in matched phases[].side + win[] pairs, ratings moved, three phase whys rewritten to agree.

audit.why: Four spikes and the right ones: his level 3-5 kit, level 6 Hijack, his Iceborn Gauntlet, and Sylas's two-item scaling. Only what spikes[1] claims Hijack does was wrong.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten — Hijack copies the ultimate, it does not take it away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page names the interaction that decides this lane: Searing Charge only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain — including the magma pillar he just planted with Volcanic Rupture. Separately, early claims Ornn's 'W passive' makes your autos deal bonus magic damage, wants.foe[1] has Brittle stacking off your autos, mid says the stolen ult leaves him standing there without it, and four fields say Abduct stuns.
audit.why: Riot's text: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar (terrain); Searing Charge (450 range, 14-12s) charges and creates a knockup shockwave only on terrain collision; Bellows Breath applies Brittle to enemies hit by the final gout, and it is Ornn's own next hit that cashes it. Sylas's Hijack casts a copy — Ornn keeps his own 100-140s ultimate. Abduct is a chain pull with no stun.
audit.corrected: Q-pillar into E knockup stated directly as the thing to position around; Brittle described as something Ornn applies to you; the Hijack-strips-him claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a spent Volcanic Rupture a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 seconds — the window is roughly half what the page promises, and a player who steps up on the strength of that number gets a pillar in the face on the way out.
All three packet suspectNames — 'Volcanic Rupture', 'Bellows Breath' — are false positives; both are Ornn's real ability names and are used in the right slots.

edits.before: Weave passive autos between every spell. Trade around Volcanic Rupture and bank small HP leads — they compound at 6.
edits.after: Searing Charge into his own Q pillar is a knockup on a 12-14s cooldown — never fight beside fresh terrain.

edits.before: Hijack online — you now own a copy of Ornn's ultimate. The all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way.
edits.after: Hijack copies Call of the Forge God — he keeps his own, and Brittle means his version lands first.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Abduct does not stun — it chains you next to a pillar he can Searing Charge into for the knockup.

edits.before: Hijack changes everything: you steal Call of the Forge God and can use Ornn's double-knockup on him, stripping his teamfight identity and flipping the all-in math.
edits.after: Hijack copies Call of the Forge God — the ram is yours on Hijack's 30-80s while his own sits on 100-140s, so over a fight you get far more casts of it than he does.

edits.before: Farm with Q Chain Lash at max range and accept that the first two levels belong to whoever avoids a mistake — Ornn's base stats are deceptively strong and his W passive means your autos trigger bonus magic damage every few hits. Do not dash in recklessly: if his Volcanic Rupture is up, a pillar on your exit path turns your E1 dash into a death trap. Instead, bait the Q cast, then punish the one-second window before his kit resets. Your W Kingslayer heal keeps you in HP parity as long as you respect the brittle proc timing — trade short when Bellows Breath is recent, trade longer when it is clearly on cooldown.
edits.after: Farm with Q Chain Lash at max range and accept that the first two levels belong to whoever avoids a mistake — Ornn's base stats are deceptively strong and Living Forge hands him extra armour and magic resist from every source he buys. Do not dash in recklessly: if his Volcanic Rupture is up, the magma pillar it leaves is terrain, and terrain is exactly what turns his Searing Charge into a knockup. Instead, bait the Q cast, then punish the seven-second window before it returns. Your W Kingslayer heal keeps you in HP parity as long as you respect Brittle — trade short when Bellows Breath is recent, trade longer when it is clearly on cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are Ornn's strongest pre-six window — his kit is fully online, Volcanic Rupture's damage is meaningful, and Bellows Breath's percent-HP component punishes your sustain-trade pattern if you stand in it. Track Volcanic Rupture's cast animation before every hook attempt: if the line misses you, his pillar never appears and his engage is gutted. At level 6 the matchup cracks open — steal Call of the Forge God and immediately look for an all-in. His own double-knockup used on him removes his ability to dodge your Q and W, and you deal out his entire engage combo to his face while he stands there without it. This is the window you have been building toward the entire laning phase.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are Ornn's strongest pre-six window — his kit is fully online, Volcanic Rupture's damage is meaningful, and Bellows Breath's percent-HP component punishes your sustain-trade pattern if you stand in it. Track the Q before every hook attempt: the pillar it plants is the terrain his 450-range Searing Charge needs to knock you up, so if the line misses, his engage is gutted for seven seconds. At level 6 you get a copy of Call of the Forge God, not his only one — he still holds his own on a 100-140s timer, so use yours to open a fight he has already spent his in, and never trade ultimates head-on while Brittle is on you.
